# JSONViewer

JSONViewer is a free, open-source, native macOS app for working with JSON. It runs
fully offline — your data never leaves your machine — and is built with SwiftUI for
Apple Silicon (arm64). It formats, validates, explores, and transforms JSON in a
single fast, private desktop window. Developers use it as a local alternative to
web-based JSON formatters and validators when they do not want to paste data into a
browser.

## Features

- Format / Beautify with 2-space, 4-space, or Tab indentation.
- Minify: collapse JSON to a single compact line.
- Validate with precise line:column error reporting.
- Syntax-highlighted text view (keys, strings, numbers, punctuation colored).
- Collapsible tree view for navigating nested structures.
- JSONPath-subset extraction, e.g. `$[*].id`, `$.users[*].email`, `$.a.b[*].x`,
  `[index]`, `['key']`; results open in a separate window with Copy and Download.
- 9 one-click transforms with line-numbered output: JSON Escape, JSON Unescape,
  BASE64 Encode, BASE64 Decode, URL Escape, URL Unescape, Gzip&BASE64Encode,
  BASE64Decode&Ungzip, String UnEscape. The gzip is real gzip, interoperable with
  the command-line `gzip` / `gunzip` tools.

## Facts

- Name: JSONViewer
- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon (arm64)
- Technology: native SwiftUI
- Price: Free (USD 0)
- License: Open source
- Privacy: Fully offline; data never leaves the machine
- Note: The release builds are unsigned; on first launch right-click the app and choose Open.
